computational_cost.note: wall clock on this container: ENVIRONMENT-SPECIFIC and not a portable figure. Each detector's figure covers its FULL declared threshold grid, so the per-threshold column is the one to compare. The series build is shared by all three and is reported on its own line rather than charged to any one of them; it dominates every detector by orders of magnitude, which is the honest headline of this row.

measures: detector delay and false alarms only
what_this_is_not: not a consequence measurement, not hardware, not flight, not autopilot execution, not pooled with any consequence phase, and not a novelty claim -- CUSUM is Page (1954) and is used as the prior-art baseline it is.
